flashcard_questions.q: A quantity that has magnitude (size) only, with no direction — for example, mass, temperature, time, speed, and distance.
A quantity that has both magnitude and direction — for example, force, velocity, displacement, and acceleration.
A push or pull acting on an object, measured in newtons (N). It has both size and direction.

flashcard_questions.a: A force that acts between objects that are physically touching — examples include friction, air resistance, tension, normal contact force, and upthrust.
The upward force exerted by a fluid on an object that is submerged or floating in it.
